name: Shrouds
description: Membrane creatures of Nohrland's mountains in Cridhe, accidentally created by Malvos and Crephas, which disguise themselves as fabric and dissolve travelers.

description_citations.text: "Shapeshifter". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Malvos and Crephas, trying to make an invisible cloak, accidentally create the shrouds.
timeline.quote: Attempting to create an invisible cloak, Malvos and Crephas combined a patch of lint from a Haenish cloak

relations.quote: The creatures they created instead are composed of a thin, transparent membrane
